issue.body:
## Problem

Scripts that call `sample-kit status` have to scrape its text output.

## Fix

Add a `--json` flag to `sample-kit status`.

## Done when

- [ ] `status --json` prints one JSON object: `{"ok": <boolean>, "pending": <number>}`.
- [ ] The README's Status section documents `--json`.
- [ ] A test runs `status --json` and checks both fields.

pr.title: feat(sample-kit): add status --json
pr.body: Adds `--json` to `sample-kit status` and documents it in the README.
